description: What a series costs a month. A video series: the tokens per episode (its film's budget, plus the day's news search and pick for a series from the news) and per month at its cadence (the most slots a month holds), against the owner's plan tokens, and what that costs the owner in dollars a month (the price of their plan when it holds it, else of the smallest plan that does), and the spend setting each episode needs to be made and posted without a card each day. Give series for one that exists (its first scheduled video type, as it is set now), or format, looks, cadence and topic for one not made yet. How an episode is made sets its budget: one in AI video costs much more than one in motion graphics made in code. A picture series or a newsletter: give series (series_create makes one free). Each set is its pictures at the picture model's price for their sizes, the picture reader's check of each, writing their prompts and captions, and X's own fee for each picture posted on X. Each issue is writing it, and checking the week is worth an email when it is written from the week. That is times the slots a month holds at its cadence, plus planning its next season when its plan runs low. Planning a season tied to its days (on this day in history, say) also checks each day's event on the web: the month counts that at its most once the series' newest season is tied to its days, and say_to_the_owner says what it would add otherwise. Sending a newsletter costs no tokens. Anything with no price yet is named in unpriced, never counted as free. Before creating or starting one, quote the month with series_quote and tell the owner the tokens each episode or issue and the month may use, whether their plan holds it, and what it costs them in dollars a month (costs_the_owner: the price of the plan that holds it). A film is charged what it really costs, up to its budget. Spends nothing.

cadence.description: How often it comes out. Or per_week.

format.description: The video type, by id: original-short (a Short, 45 to 60 seconds) or original-long (a film of 8 to 12 minutes). The first when left out.

looks.description: For a Short not made yet, how it is made: drawn (motion graphics made in code) or clips or mix (with AI video), each at what an episode made that way may use. Left out: the Short a new series starts with. Another length or look is quoted by making the series (free) and its type (series_video_type_set), then quoting it by name.

per_week.description: Episodes a week, 0 to 21 (7 is every day). Instead of cadence.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

series.description: A series' id or exact name (series_read). Leave out to quote one not made yet.

topic.description: For a series from the day's news: what the news is about. Any value quotes the news search and pick with each episode.

name: series_quote
title: Quote a series' month
